# Sitespeakai

SiteSpeakAI enables businesses to automate customer support by creating custom-trained, embeddable GPT chatbots that provide real-time answers about products and services, reducing support tickets.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/sitespeakai/.

## Actions

- **Get Authenticated User** (read-only): Retrieve details of the authenticated user account.
- **Get Smart Prompts** (read-only): Retrieve smart prompts available for a chatbot.
- **List Chatbots** (read-only): List all chatbots.
